confidence_notes: I ran two web searches: one for the RBA rate and one for Havana restaurant, beer and coffee prices. The RBA rate is the AUD/USD reading of 0.6720 at 4.00 pm on 18 November 2026. The price sources disagree and are partly dated. Traveltables was last updated in 2023 and MyLifeElsewhere gave different figures. Cuba's dual-currency and informal dollar pricing makes prices volatile. Beer, coffee, inexpensive meal and mid-range meal are based on those aggregates, with tourist-oriented paladar prices weighted higher. Cocktail and wine are estimated from the local price relationship to beer, because I found no direct data. All four accommodation anchors are holistic estimates, not searched. Casa particular prices are used as the basis for the hostel and 1-star anchors, and hotel prices in USD are volatile.
comparable_city_reasoning: Compared with other Caribbean and Latin American tourist cities with low local prices but a tourist-priced paladar and casa particular sector, such as Santo Domingo or Santiago de Cuba, adjusted upward for Havana's tourist pricing.
